title: Resolve workspace differences
subtitle: Local guest data and account data do not match. Review the merge plan before switching to the account workspace.
defaults: Conservative defaults are selected: account data wins conflicts, local-only entries are discarded, and account-only entries are kept unless you change them.

project.title: Project: {{name}}
project.onlyLocal: Exists only in the local guest workspace.
project.onlyAccount: Exists only in the account workspace.
project.same: Project data matches on both sides.
project.different: Project contents differ between guest and account.
project.dataDifferent: Items, recipes, tags, and other project data differ.

graph.title: Graph: {{name}}
graph.onlyLocal: Graph exists only in the local guest workspace.
graph.onlyAccount: Graph exists only in the account workspace.
graph.same: Graph data matches on both sides.
graph.different: Graph contents differ between guest and account.

keepOne: The merge must keep at least one project.
